answer: Gate each seat behind a funded bidirectional payment channel: an applicant must lock real capital in a channel to an established member and keep genuine value routing through it every epoch. Locked liquidity cannot sit in two channels at once, so a swarm cannot spiral outward on one shared bankroll, it must fund each clone separately. Picture the member graph as a jade lattice where every live channel is a load-bearing thread; we countersign each commitment like a quill on a ledger, and an identity with an empty idle channel routes nothing and starves out.
